topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: studies that decode words or utterances from non-acoustic signals by classifying each detected segment into a closed set of at most a few hundred words or utterances, with or without a language-model or context prior; open-vocabulary decoders without a closed-set word test and acoustic-only ASR excluded.
topics.design_field: model_family; full-text regexes hmm_viterbi, linear_discriminant, svm, deep_network

topics.inclusion_rule: Brain-signal (ECoG, sEEG, intracortical, EEG, MEG) speech or language decoders whose ledger text names a speech unit and decoding or classification; the design of interest is the use-time prior over outputs: language model, grammar or finite-state network, pronunciation lexicon, or a context prior derived from another decoded utterance (for example a decoded question constraining the answer). A study counts under every design its full text names (upper bound); priors used only in training do not count; versions once.
topics.pattern: brain signal AND speech unit AND decod/classif/recogni (ledger text)
topics.design_field: full-text regexes language_model, grammar_or_finite_state, pronunciation_lexicon, dialogue_context_prior
topics.metric: answer accuracy with versus without the prior

topics.inclusion_rule: Intracranial (ECoG, sEEG, intracortical) speech decoding studies whose ledger text mentions real-time, online or closed-loop operation; the design of interest is what the evaluation reports for that operation: an online accuracy or error-rate figure, an offline simulation or replay of the real-time pipeline, and a numeric latency. Boundary: listening-only and review papers enter through the pattern, so counts are upper bounds; versions once.
topics.pattern: intracranial AND speech unit AND real-time/online/closed-loop (ledger text)
